notes.title: 🚨 New Update – Miami Hotel Simulator! 🚨
notes.content:
[h3]Hey players![/h3]
 
The latest update is here. Patch notes:

[h3][b]New Features:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Bartending: Serve cocktails to customers.
[*] Finance App: Track income and expenses with a graph.
[*] Third-Person Mode: Play the game from a new perspective.
[*] Movable Items: Move kitchen items, including the washing machine, food buffet, and plate holder.
[/list]

[h3][b]Performance:[/b]
[/h3][list]
[*] Optimized netcode.
[*] Improved overall performance.
[/list]
[h3][b]Vehicles:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted car specs.
[*] Fixed glitches with player-owned car physics.
[*] Fixed cars sometimes flipping when exiting.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the Spanish translation.
[/list]

Update now and enjoy the new features!

notes.title: 🌴 Miami Hotel Simulator – OUT NOW! 🛎️
notes.content:
[h3][b]🎉 The day has come, hotel managers![/b][/h3][p] Miami Hotel Simulator is officially out now and waiting for YOU to step into the sun-soaked world of hospitality!

Start with a run-down building and transform it into the ultimate hotel paradise.
Decorate, renovate, and bring life back to every floor, room, and hallway. Satisfy your guests, boost your income, and turn your business into a booming Miami success story!

Whether you're a perfectionist planner or a chaotic manager, there's a place for you in Miami 🌞

 Set up vending machines, serve food, and handle unexpected hotel challenges. Will your guests leave 5-star reviews or storm out demanding refunds? 😅 That’s up to you!

✨ We're incredibly excited to share this game with you, and we can’t wait to hear what you think.

 Please share your feedback, suggestions, bugs, or just your craziest hotel stories – it all helps us make the game even better!

[b]Thank you for being part of this journey – and welcome to Miami![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="BzFVXzwYewA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]

notes.title: 🛎️ Co-op Playtests are LIVE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey hoteliers! 🌴[/h3]

We’ve got some exciting news straight from sunny Miami — [b]Co-op Playtests are now OPEN![/b] ☀️👥

 That’s right — you can now team up with friends and run your dream hotel together. Split tasks, decorate rooms, stock vending machines, serve up food, and keep those guests smiling as a team. 💼🛏️🍔

This is your chance to get an early look at how multiplayer will work — and help us make it even better. The co-op mode is still in development, so expect a few hiccups here and there. And that’s where you come in!

[b]👉 Found a bug?
 👉 Got ideas or feedback?
 👉 Something just feels off?[/b]

Let us know! Every bit of feedback helps us polish the experience and make the co-op mode as fun and smooth as possible.

Thank you for being part of this journey — and have fun turning your hotel into the ultimate Miami paradise, now with friends by your side! 🌇✨

[h3][b]💬 Drop your feedback in the Steam forums or via the in-game report tool. We’re reading everything![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Welcome Back to the Hotel, Managers! The Free Prologue Gets a Major Upgrade!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967700

Calling all aspiring hoteliers! We're thrilled to announce a significant update to the [b]Miami Hotel Simulator Free Prologue[/b] available now on Steam! This isn't just a bug fix patch – we've completely overhauled the prologue experience to give you a deeper taste of what awaits in the full game.

[b]Get Ready to Refine Your Hospitality Skills[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Remastered Food & Economy System:[/b] We've reworked the way food service functions, along with a complete economic overhaul, for a more dynamic and strategic hotel management experience.
[*][b] Vending Machine Mania:[/b] Guests can now quench their thirst and satisfy their sweet tooth with the addition of brand new vending machines offering ice cream, alcoholic beverages, and of course, coffee!
[*] [b]Furnish Your Dreamscape:[/b] Unleash your inner interior decorator with a whopping 40 new furniture items to personalize your hotel and create a truly unique atmosphere!
[*] [b]Second Floor Unlocked:[/b] Expand your hospitality empire with the opening of the previously inaccessible second floor, allowing you to accommodate even more guests!
[*] [b]Performance & Bug Fixes:[/b] We've implemented a variety of optimizations and bug fixes to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gameplay experience.
[/list]


[b]This is just a taste of what's to come in the full version of Miami Hotel Simulator![/b] We're constantly working to refine the experience and can't wait for you to dive into the complete hotel management simulation.

Don't forget to [b]Wishlist[/b] the full game to stay updated on its release!

In the meantime, [b]download the FREE Prologue now[/b] and start building your dream hotel today!

notes.title: 🌴🏨 Miami Hotel Simulator Demo Now Available! 🏨🌴
notes.content:
The wait is over! We're thrilled to announce that the demo for Miami Hotel Simulator is finally here, ready for you to dive into the exciting world of hotel management!

🌟 What You Can Experience:

[list]
[*]Step into the bustling streets of Miami and immerse yourself in the energetic vibe of this iconic city.
[*]Take on the role of a hotel manager and tackle the challenges of running a successful hospitality business.
[*]Explore the demo version, which offers a glimpse into the full game experience, allowing you to get a feel for the gameplay mechanics and features.
[*]Design and customize your very own hotel and watch as your creation comes to life.
[*]Unlimited playtime. We didn't want to separate you from your hotel.
[/list]

🌟 What the Full Game Will Offer:

[list]
[*]Multiplayer! Manage the hotel along with your friends.
[*]Open World. Visit wholesale markets, pawnshops, gas stations, etc., and explore more.
[*]More content like furnitures and customization.
[*]More services you can offer for customers.
[*]More language support.
[*]Deeper systems; room temperature, electricity consumption, water costs, air conditioners, etc.
[*]Spend the money you earn at car dealer, clothes shop.
[/list]

Don't forget to [b]whishlist [/b] and share you experience with us on the Steam Hub. 

Get ready to experience the thrill of running your own luxury hotel. Your Miami adventure starts now! 🌴🏨✨
